title: Introducing PowerPoint in Vesence
summary: The most powerful agentic PowerPoint editor in the world. Work side by side with agents on real PowerPoint decks, with every number cited and every change tracked.
body_markdown:
AI has made it easy to build slides as web pages. HTML decks are quick to make and nice to share, and we like them too. But the decks that decide things still live in PowerPoint.


The board pack, the pitch, the credit paper. They follow a firm’s template, they travel by email, and many hands edit them right up to the meeting. We believe the PowerPoint editor will stay at the center of that work for a long time. So we built our agents into one.


## A real PowerPoint editor


Open any .pptx and work on it as you would in PowerPoint. Your template, your fonts and your layouts stay as they are, and you get a .pptx back.


- Edit anything.


Text, tables and shapes, with the shortcuts you already use, like ⌘B.
- Lay out slides fast.


Align, distribute and match sizes in one click.
- Pro tools, built in.


The tools consultants usually buy add-ins for, like Swap Positions.


## Agents that work in your deck


Select a shape and say what you need. The agent reads the files in your project and the emails in your inbox, and edits the slide for you.


- Update the numbers.


Pull new figures from a model into a table.
- Use what came in by email.


Take a confirmed figure from a colleague’s message.
- Build new slides.


Ask for a slide and it appears where you want it.
